Manifest.Name: Precision Lab Equipment / 精密实验室设备
Manifest.Author: DeepSeek Harness Agent
Manifest.Description: 新增三件实验设备：精确取液器、提纯机器、微生物培养机（用含糖液体培养菌群，无营养果槽；可产粗制抗生素培养液，再经提纯机浓缩、成型机装瓶）。新增淀粉酸性水解、肾上腺素注射笔、纳洛酮、赛纳普雷斯特、蓝血、抗生素等多条生产线，以及抗辐射药片生产线（放射性废料+碘化钾→普鲁士蓝螯合→SOD→微囊→API→药片）、嗅盐、药剂师原料工坊、售货机医疗品周抽等系统。 / Adds a Precision Liquid Extractor, Purification Machine and Microbial Cultivator (sugary-liquid culture, no nutrifruit slot; crude antibiotic culture -> purifier -> bottled antibiotics), starch hydrolysis, and adrenaline/naloxone/Synaprest/blue-blood/antibiotic production lines, plus smelling salts, the apothecary ingredient workshop, and a weekly medical vending draw.
